latestWeeks.title: Latest N weeks
latestWeeks.description: Number of most recent weeks to return. Ignored when a date range is set.

from.title: From (week end on or after)
from.description: Optional start date (YYYY-MM-DD). The series starts in January 2005.

format.title: Output format
enumTitles: One row per week (all series as fields)
One row per week × flow × asset class
format.description: Wide is convenient for spreadsheets; long is convenient for BI tools and charts.

onlyNew.title: Monitoring mode: new weeks and revisions only
onlyNew.description: Remember the published values of each week and output only new weeks (changeType = new) and weeks whose published values changed (changeType = revision). Schedule weekly after the release (usually Thursday, Japan time; holidays shift it — see the MOF release schedule).

stateKey.title: Monitoring state key
stateKey.description: Separate state per schedule. Letters, digits, - and _ only.
